claim: Reprogramming the piezo controller's firmware with NanoFlash cannot damage it even if interrupted, since programming can always be resumed; but the wrong firmware version, while harmless to the controller, may leave it unable to drive stages or missing key features until the right one is loaded.
validity_conditions: Read from NanoFlash Reflash Application User Manual (sha256 98fbdbf6...): printed page 5 (PDF page 5), printed page 13 (PDF page 13). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
